arguments.reasoning: The original first decision proposed control_search raising control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight from 0.05 to {0.075,0.10} with control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight fixed at 0.05, predicting holding_max_speed_m_s below the incumbent 0.012750255515948416 m/s while keeping holding_max_error_m and terminal_error_m at or below 0.01 m. Both newly completed pilot executions now falsify that direction on the nominal case: the 0.075 point (F75=0.023285947509969908) and the 0.10 point (F71=0.022128674933740447) both exceed the 0.02 m/s holding-speed limit and are the only failing component (F188=false, F173=false), while reach and holding position pass (F129=F131=true; F63=F69=true) and both terminal (F113=0.002633323294646377, F215=0.0028347191207395775) and holding position (F125=0.0028109103441942935, F146=0.002905756064671871) stay under 0.01. So raising the holding penalty raised, not lowered, in-window tip speed; the incumbent (F122=0.012750255515948416, F156=accepted) keeps the best margin. The two pilot points also reproduce the matched historical failures at the same scientific configuration identities (holding 0.075: F75=F166 equal; holding 0.10: F71=F89 equal), so they add replication of a known failure rather than a new signal; the original replication_reason was null and no repetition intent is inferred. The passing joint-weight point (F7=0.010201160469407439, F79=accepted, holding 0.09 with terminal 0.10) is confounded by the simultaneous terminal change and cannot attribute the speed reduction to any single lever. The frozen question concerns robustness to prescribed small initial-state variation, but only the zero-perturbation nominal case is executable here (the four perturbation cases are deferred and the local numerical saved-state route is an explicit capability gap), so no currently legal executable action can address that robustness uncertainty. Given the refuted lever, the unreachable robustness route, and an already-accepted incumbent, further nominal-only spending has little scientific value. This is a voluntary model STOP, not an acceptance/optimality/robustness/causality claim.
